question.prompt:
A cone has base radius 3 and slant height 5. Its total surface area is \(k\pi\). Find the value of \(k\).

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_258_q3_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: Total surface area = lateral surface area + base area \(=\pi\times 3\times 5+\pi\times 3^2=24\pi\), so \(k=24\).
solutions.title: Add the lateral and base areas
